Application Data.NAME: Carpet Solutions Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Carpet Solutions Inc. provides professional floor covering and carpet installation services, specializing in residential and commercial projects. Our operations include the sale, installation, and maintenance of a wide variety of flooring materials such as carpet, hardwood, laminate, vinyl, and tile. We operate primarily from our retail location, where customers can view samples and consult with our experienced staff. Our installation team is trained to adhere to industry best practices, ensuring high-quality workmanship and customer satisfaction. Additionally, we implement rigorous safety protocols to minimize risks associated with our projects, including proper handling of materials and adherence to environmental guidelines. To support our services, we also offer aftercare maintenance and cleaning solutions to prolong the life of installed products. Overall, we focus on delivering exceptional service while managing potential risks associated with our operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2022, a water damage claim was filed due to improper installation of vinyl flooring in a residential property, resulting in a loss amount of $7,500. The claim was closed on June 10, 2022, with a status of Paid. On September 22, 2023, a small theft incident occurred at a job site where tools valued at $3,000 were stolen; the claim is currently pending assessment.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: B Rated Safe, UL Listed, F1 Fire Resistant, 1200 lbs Capacity
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Installed security fencing and hired off-duty police officers for job site protection during high-value installations.
